name: Coarse Time
description: Coarse time counter. Instrument clock, in seconds, when the packet is built. Set by OBC Time at Tone command.

name: Fine Time

name: Ancillary Data
description: Placeholder.

name: Runtime
description: Seconds since the last boot; wraps at 2^32 s. Absolute time is in the secondary header.

name: PPS Offset
description: Offset between the instrument clock and the last PPS edge. Currently always 0: not yet populated by the collector.

name: Commands Received
description: Commands received.

name: Commands Accepted
description: Commands accepted.

name: Commands Rejected
description: Commands rejected.

name: Status Flags
description: Instrument status, refreshed every HK interval; only Sequence Error is latched.

name: Error Flags
description: Error flags. Most bits are sticky for the run: a condition occurred, not how often or whether it is still true.

name: Power []
description: 15 power-rail monitors, raw 12-bit ADC codes; conversion is ground-side.

name: Temperature []
description: 8 temperature monitors, raw 12-bit ADC codes; conversion is ground-side.

name: Reserved
description: Reserved, always zero. Byte-aligns the fields that follow the 12-bit/4-bit run.

name: Thread A Mode
description: Science thread A product selector (Thread Mode). Values: see Thread Control (0x0A).

name: Thread B Mode
description: Science thread B product selector (Thread Mode). Values: see Thread Control (0x0A).

name: Ring Overruns
description: Events lost since boot because a science channel was lapped on the event ring, threads A and B summed.

name: Capture Overrun
description: Events lost since boot because the capture ring lapped before the drain reached them.

name: Ring Overrun Count
description: Number of times a science channel has been lapped since boot.

name: Capture Overrun Count
description: Number of times the capture ring has lapped since boot.

name: Fault Code
description: Subsystem-specific code for that fault.

name: Fault Count
description: Total faults since boot.

name: Fault Source
description: Subsystem that raised the last fault. Values: Fault Source (see table below).

name: Dropped Transfer Frames
description: Inbound transfer frames discarded by the transport since boot (resync, bad checksum, bad length), both links summed.

name: Version Minor

name: Version Patch
description: Firmware semantic version, patch.

name: Reserved
description: Reserved, always zero. Aligns the fields after the three version bytes to 16 bits.

name: Reset Cause
description: Raw resetSource_t from the last boot. A commanded software reset reads 0x0010 SW_RESET.

name: Thread A Period
description: Thread A cadence.

name: Thread B Period
description: Thread B cadence.

name: Scrub Corrected
description: Lifetime single-bit ECC repairs by the NVM scrubber.

name: Scrub Uncorrectable
description: Lifetime double-bit ECC detections — not repairable onboard.

name: Disabled Pixels
description: Pixels disabled by hot-pixel detection.

name: NVM Erase Total
description: Lifetime bank-7 sector erases. Does not saturate.

name: NVM FSM Stuck Count
description: Flash-FSM give-ups this boot. RAM-only.

name: Fault Clears
description: SAFE releases this boot, commanded plus autonomous. RAM-only.

name: Boot Count
description: Total boots of this unit, from the persistent stats record (SL_stats). 32 bits, matching the stored type.

name: Last Severity
description: Severity of the most recent fault.

name: Fault Total

name: Fault Severity []
description: Per-severity fault histogram.

name: Last Source
description: Subsystem that raised the most recent fault (Fault Source). Values: Fault Source (see table below).

name: Last Code
description: Subsystem-specific code for it.

name: CPU Busy
description: Processor busy fraction over the last measurement interval, 0..1000. Computed on the box.

name: CPU Busy Peak
description: Worst busy fraction of any interval since boot, 0..1000.

name: Capture Drained
description: ADC results the drain consumed: EVERY captured pair, good or not.

name: Capture False Event
description: Complete pair carrying the reserved all-zeros address. Not a loss.

name: Capture Multi Edges
description: MULTI edges counted in the ISR before attribution: the m in the dead-time correction n = m/(1 - m*tau).

name: Capture Multi Dropped
description: Events discarded because their slot carried a mark.

name: Capture Multi Late
description: Edges that could not be attributed at all. A SUBSET of Capture Multi Edges.

name: Capture Overrun
description: Events lost because the capture ring lapped before the drain reached them.

name: Sequence Failed
description: Latched: did the last sequence run fail. Survives until the next Run Sequence.

name: Sequence Index
description: Which sequence failed.

name: Sequence Step
description: Which step index.

name: Sequence NACK Reason
description: The handler's NACK code for that step.

name: Sequence OpCode
description: That step's opcode.

name: Energy Edges (8 bins) []

description: PPS adoption mode. Values: PPS Mode (see table below).

name: Hot Pixel Factor
description: Hot-pixel sensitivity: a pixel is disabled when its count exceeds Factor x the mean count of the pixels that fired. 0 = detection off.

name: NSP Routing Enabled
description: NSP command routing enabled (RADICALS only).

name: NSP Default Command
description: Default 5-bit NSP command for outgoing packets. RADICALS only.

name: Total Events
description: Events detected in the window.

name: Saturation
description: Summed excess across all bins: counts that did not fit their cell (a cell counts 0..2^n-2; 2^n-1 marks saturation).

name: Multi Events
description: MULTI (pile-up) edges attributed to the window: the m in the dead-time correction n = m/(1 - m*tau).

name: Sample Rate
description: Window length in 50 ms base ticks (the thread's cadence).

name: Energy Underflow
description: Events below the lowest bin edge, all pixels combined.

name: Energy Overflow
description: Events above the highest bin edge, all pixels combined.

name: Pixel Data
description: Cells in pixel order, bin 0 first. 256 cells, each 6 bits deep.
